shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; git log --stat | head -30; head -40 package-lock.json
cat index.html src/* tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules | head -100; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && cat uikit/package.json | grep -E '"version"|peerDep' -A3 | head; ls uikit/build/esm/components/theme/; cat uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.js; cat uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts; cat icons/package.json | grep version; ls icons | head; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs 2>/dev/null | head -5
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Portal/Portal.js | head -40; ls; grep -o 'g-root{[^}]*}' ../../../styles/styles.css | head -3

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && grep -oE '\.g-root\{[^}]*\}|body\{[^}]*\}|\.g-root_theme_dark\{.{0,200}' styles/styles.css | head; ls build/esm/components/tabs build/esm/components/layout; grep -l "export" build/esm/components/tabs/*.d.ts | head

ls styles; grep -oE '(^|\})[^{}]*\.g-root[^{}]*\{[^}]{0,300}' styles/styles.css | grep -v -- '--g-' | head; cat build/esm/components/tabs/TabList.d.ts build/esm/components/tabs/Tab.d.ts build/esm/components/tabs/types.d.ts | head -120
grep -A8 -E '^(body)?\.g-root \{' styles/styles.css | head -30; sed -n 1,80p build/esm/components/tabs/Tab.js | grep -nE 'href|onClick|aria|role' | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && ls icons | grep -E '^(Sun|Moon|House|ListCheck|CircleInfo|Plus|TrashBin)\.js$'; grep -E 'export \{ (Flex|Container|Text|Card|Switch|Button|Icon|Link|TextInput|Checkbox|Label)\b' uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts uikit/build/esm/components/*/index.d.ts uikit/build/esm/components/layout/index.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "export" uikit/build/esm/components/tabs/index.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat controls/types.d.ts | sed -n 1,60p | grep -nE 'onUpdate|checked|content|size' ; grep -nE 'view|type|theme|size' Card/Card.d.ts | head; grep -n "TEXT_VARIANTS\|variant" Text/text/text.d.ts | head -5; grep -oE "'(display|header|subheader|body|caption)-[0-9a-z-]+'" Text/text/text.js | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '
cat Switch/Switch.d.ts | head -20; grep -nE 'checked|onUpdate|content' controls/types.d.ts | head; grep -nE '^\s+(gap|direction|alignItems|justifyContent|spacing|wrap)\??:' layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts
rm -rf /home/sandbox/workspace/dist; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npx --no-install playwright --version 2>&1 | head -1

cat > /tmp/ssrcheck/vite.config.mjs <<'EOF'
export default { root: '/home/sandbox/workspace', ssr: { noExternal: [/@gravity-ui/] } };
EOF
npx vite-node --config /tmp/ssrcheck/vite.config.mjs /tmp/ssrcheck/check.tsx 2>&1 | grep -v useLayoutEffect | tail -15
sed -i "1i import React from 'react';" /tmp/ssrcheck/check.tsx && npx vite-node --config /tmp/ssrcheck/vite.config.mjs /tmp/ssrcheck/check.tsx 2>&1 | grep -v useLayoutEffect | tail -15
